tagline: 理光便携相机，1987 年发布
description: 理光于1987年推出的便携相机。快门速度Programmed electronic shutter, 1–1/500 s.。使用Easy loading, motor advance and rewind. Last bit of leader left out.。感光度DX decoding from 64 to 1600 ISO. Non-DX films set at ISO 100.。Autofocus with pre-focus ability, closest range 0,9 m.。

specs.对焦: Autofocus with pre-focus ability, closest range 0,9 m.
specs.取景器: Albada type with bright lines, parallax correction marks and zone indication. Adjusted according to lens focal length. 0,7–0,38 x magnification, 84–87 % field of view.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in pop-up flash, automatically activated with flash-matic exposure. Can be used as fill flash. GN 12. Reloads in 2–3 seconds.
specs.感光度: DX decoding from 64 to 1600 ISO. Non-DX films set at ISO 100.
specs.胶片/画幅: Easy loading, motor advance and rewind. Last bit of leader left out.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh TF-500 or TF-900 is a late 80s compact camera with autofocus and a 35 mm lens, switchable to 70 mm through a button on the top.
